newsitem.title: USA: Astra USA ex-CFO charged with filing false return.
newsitem.headline: Astra USA ex-CFO charged with filing false return.

text.p: A former chief financial officer of Astra U.S.A. on Thursday was charged with filing a false income tax return, a day after its former chief executive was indicted on fraud charges.
The former CFO, Stefan E. Solvell, 42, was named as an unindicted co-conspirator in an indictment returned Wednesday against former Astra U.S.A. President and CEO Lars Bildman.
Astra U.S.A. is a unit of Swedish pharmaceuticals house Astra Ab.

Bildman is accused of defrauding the company of more than $1.0 million, using the money to maintain and renovate three homes, and pay for family vacations and trips to Florida, where he allegedly rendezvoused with prostitutes aboard chartered yachts.
According to a so-called criminal Information complaint, filed at U.S. District Court in Boston, Solvell and his wife filed an income tax return in which more than $20,000 was unreported.
In addition to fraud charges, Bildman was similarly accused of filing false income tax returns.
Bildman was arraigned Thursday in Vermont where he was arrested at his vacation home. Solvell is expected to surrender voluntarily in Boston.
